subject: Re: Elara expansion — short-term buffer and slot migration proposal
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@elara.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam Harper <liam.harper@elara.ai>, Procurement <procurement@elara.ai>
Date: 2028-06-18T15:12:00Z
Subject: Continued Q2 surge — request for expansion runway

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from our side — thanks again for the review last week. Our telemetry shows a sustained 28% increase in generation volume versus forecast over the last 6 weeks; tail latency and token surge events are causing several downstream throttles in our inference pipeline.

Attached is a CSV export of Q2 usage (hourly buckets) and a short summary table. We need to discuss:
- A temporary cushion while we finalize the model optimization work (2–6 weeks)
- A long-term slot mix change to move some capacity to higher-concurrency H100 pools

Can Redwood provide a short-term buffer of ~20% additional dedicated slots for 30 days while we complete profiling? If possible wed also like a proposal for migrating 40% of our current Slab A capacity to a Slab B (higher concurrency) profile and the estimated cost delta.

I copied Liam (ops) and our procurement address so we can accelerate any SOW/PO steps.

Thanks,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Platform
Elara AI

Attachment: elara_usage_report_q2.csv (CSV, 220KB)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@elara.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Liam Harper <liam.harper@elara.ai>, Procurement <procurement@elara.ai>
Date: 2028-06-19T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Continued Q2 surge — request for expansion runway

Sofia — thanks for the data, and for clearly calling out the two-part ask. Weve reviewed the CSV and ran a quick utilization simulation. Short answer: yes, we can provide a 30-day buffer while you stabilize, plus a recommended slot migration blueprint. High-level: 

- Short-term buffer: +20% dedicated slots on your current Slab A pool, provisioned as a temporary tranche (non-committal) for 30 days. This will prioritize latency SLOs and reduce tail events.
- Migration blueprint: proposed move of 40% of Slab A to Slab B (higher concurrency H100-backed). We include an ops checklist (warm cache, KV-prefetching, live A/B rollout) to minimize request disruption.

Im attaching a draft SOW and an initial proposed slot mix so you can review. Ben will follow up with the cost delta and contract-level options (temporary buffer vs. committed tranche).

Next steps:
1) Ben to send pricing and amendment language.
2) If pricing acceptable, well issue an addendum + DocuSign SOW and spin the buffer immediately.
3) Priyom will schedule a short tech run-through for migration playbook.

Let us know any timing constraints for procurement.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sow_draft.pdf (PDF, 60KB); proposed-slot-mix.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@elara.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@elara.ai>
Date: 2028-06-19T11:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Continued Q2 surge — request for expansion runway

Hi Sofia,

Pricing summary (ballpark) for the two options you asked about — all figures are USD/month and assume current model mix: 

Option A (temporary buffer — 30 days, non-committal): +20% dedicated slots provisioned on Slab A. One-time provisioning fee waived for 30-day buffer. Billing is pro-rated daily. Estimated incremental charge: $12,400 (pro-rated for 30d).

Option B (committed tranche + migration): Convert 40% of your Slab A commitment to Slab B (higher-concurrency H100 profile). This requires a 3-month minimum tranche addendum to amortize rebalancing costs. Estimated incremental run-rate: $8,700/month (after committed discount). Theres an up-front one-time migration / warmup credit of $3,000 to cover performance tuning and KV cache seeding.

Recommendation: If you need immediate relief and arent ready to commit, take Option A now to remove risk. We can then roll into Option B mid-July after your profiling completes to realize lower monthly cost.

Im dropping a quick comparison spreadsheet into the SOW (sow_draft.pdf) and tagging the line items with our account codes. If procurement needs a PO-friendly invoice, I can generate that immediately.

-Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_line_items.xls (referenced inside sow_draft.pdf)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@elara.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@elara.ai>, Liam Harper <liam.harper@elara.ai>
Date: 2028-06-25T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Continued Q2 surge — request for expansion runway

Thanks all — Sofia, sounds like we have alignment. Quick operational notes before procurement: 

- We will spin the 30-day +20% buffer on Monday (2028-06-27) at 08:00 PT assuming you provide a green-light by end-of-day Friday. This is non-committal and will be billed pro-rata as Ben outlined.
- Priyom and my team will run the 45-minute migration dry-run on 2028-07-03 (invite to follow) so we can validate KV warm-up and latency baselines for the Slab B transition.
- Ben: please prepare the PO-ready invoice and include the migration credit line item. Sofia / Procurement: once you confirm, I will send the DocuSign SOW link to expedite.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/embedded/abc123-elara-sow

If procurement needs a change in billing cadence or region mapping for cost allocation (we can map part of Slab B to eu-west if youd like), flag that now.

Kim
